scope: Une attaque automatique propre à chacune des trente mascottes ; critiques à trois, quatre ou cinq coups avec lueurs, auras et particules thématiques.

tests.geometry: Thirty distinct motifs remain different after removing colours and identity attributes.
tests.legacy: Old journals with or without config.effects keep their health and results; former effect choices no longer override mascot attacks.

browser.direction: All thirty previewed in both directions; real portraits determine horizontal or vertical targets.
browser.game: Offline Koi water jet and Kitsune fire tornado; four and five critical hits respectively, each deducting exactly twenty health points once.
browser.critical: Three-to-five-hit sequences, themed glow, two auras and twenty animated sparkles; complete inside the minimum one-second correction.
browser.teams: Two complete offline duels on each viewport; every answering member uses their own signature; 100% health per pair, fixed initial draw, final team score 2–0.
browser.resume: Both mascot identities, health and actions retained; new journals contain no effect-selection setting.
browser.accessibility: No attack selector; image-only mascot choices and read-only signature previews; axe reports zero violations; active animations retained with reduced-motion preference.

checks.lint: oxlint passed; 81 pre-existing warnings, no new warning in this increment
checks.secrets: Scoped Gitleaks result in secrets-results.json; not a global F22 audit.

paper.fonts: same pinned fonts; baseline Google CSS response served from local assets

limits: The duel uses a shared screen; synchronization between devices remains open.
No Cloudflare production deployment, new audio synthesis or cloud configuration publication.
Offline play requires preparing the media and keeping the page open.
The V4 proposal of 200 KB for the complete game remains open; provisional route budgets passed.
